I will farm this maize piece the way I can manage with my own money and hands. My land is small, and I own it, so I will put compost and a little fertilizer if I can get it, but I will not risk spending too much cash. I will use improved seed only if I can buy a small amount in time, because I have seen other farmers get better cobs with it when the rains are good. I do not use spray much here, and I will depend mostly on family work for weeding and planting.
